queries.sql: SELECT `listings`.*, `categories`.`name` AS `category_name`, `users`.`name` AS `owner_name`, `users`.`rating_avg` AS `owner_rating`, `users`.`rating_count` AS `owner_rating_count`, (SELECT filename FROM listing_images li WHERE li.listing_id = listings.id ORDER BY li.sort_order, li.id LIMIT 1) AS cover FROM `listings` JOIN `categories` ON `categories`.`id` = `listings`.`category_id` JOIN `users` ON `users`.`id` = `listings`.`user_id` WHERE `listings`.`status` IN ('tersedia','diproses') ORDER BY `listings`.`id` DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM listings l WHERE l.category_id = c.id AND l.status = 'tersedia') AS open_count FROM `categories` `c` WHERE `c`.`is_active` = 1 ORDER BY `c`.`name`
